overall_summary: Husband-wife relationship dynamics consistently outperform generic emotional or family content by 5x to 10x in view volume and engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) generated the highest views and likes.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on real-life married couple misunderstandings and unsaid emotional distance.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister/Brother videos scored low (19-136 views) and abstract Shayari scored lowest (15 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid broad poetic lines and generic family tributes without a specific everyday narrative hook.

next_video.concept: A wife quieted down after years of complaining, and her husband misinterprets silence as peace.
next_video.opening_direction: Show a dinner table scene where the wife no longer reminds her husband to eat on time.
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that when a partner stops complaining, it isn't peace—it is the moment they stopped expecting.
next_video.reason: Top performing video 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' was published around 13:12 UTC/18:42 IST and hit peak engagement with married audience.

experiment: Testing whether framed silence in a marriage drives higher comment-section debate than direct relationship advice.
